This market will resolve according to the team that remains without a single loss the longest during the 2026-27 NFL regular season.

Ties do not count as losses.

If at any point it becomes impossible for the listed team to be the last team remaining without a loss, the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

If multiple teams suffer their first loss on the same day, or if multiple teams finish the 2026-27 NFL regular season without a loss, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team that played the most games before recording its first loss, regardless of the number of ties recorded by those teams.

If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team with the greater strength of victory in all games, and then the tied team with the greater strength of schedule in all games, as those terms are used in the NFL's official tie-breaking procedures (https://www.nfl.com/standings/tie-breaking-procedures). If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team whose full team name, as listed in this market, comes first alphabetically. The "Other" option will not be considered in these tie-breaks.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed after January 24, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the team that remained without a loss the longest cannot be determined within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL (https://www.nfl.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

This market will resolve according to the team that remains without a single win the longest during the 2026-27 NFL regular season.

Ties do not count as wins.

If at any point it becomes impossible for the listed team to be the last team remaining without a win, the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

If multiple teams earn their first win on the same day, or if multiple teams finish the 2026-27 NFL regular season without a win, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team that played the most games before recording its first win, regardless of the number of ties recorded by those teams.

If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team with the greater strength of victory in all games, and then the tied team with the greater strength of schedule in all games, as those terms are used in the NFL's official tie-breaking procedures (https://www.nfl.com/standings/tie-breaking-procedures). If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team whose full team name, as listed in this market, comes first alphabetically. The "Other" option will not be considered in these tie-breaks.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed after January 24, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the team that remained without a win the longest cannot be determined within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL (https://www.nfl.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

This market will resolve to the team defense and special teams (D/ST) unit that finishes Week 4 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season as the highest-scoring D/ST under the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports.

Only games designated by the NFL as Week 4 of the 2026-27 regular season count. If two or more units are tied for the most fantasy points in Week 4, this market will resolve in favor of the tied unit whose team name comes first alphabetically.

If the highest-scoring D/ST in Week 4 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is not a listed unit, this market will resolve to "Other".

If Week 4 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past October 21, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or a leader cannot be determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source will be official Week 4 statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

This market will resolve according to the team that wins the 2026 Polymarket Fantasy League championship. The Polymarket Fantasy League is an ESPN Fantasy Football league (https://fantasy.espn.com/football/league?leagueId=447376974). The champion is the team that wins the league's playoff championship matchup, scheduled for Week 17 of the 2026 NFL season (December 31, 2026 to January 4, 2027), as determined by the league's settings on ESPN Fantasy. If the championship matchup ends in a tie, the champion will be the team that ESPN Fantasy declares the winner under the league's playoff tiebreaker settings.

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed team to win the 2026 Polymarket Fantasy League championship per the league's settings on ESPN Fantasy (e.g., they fail to qualify for or are eliminated from the playoffs), the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

Listed teams refer to the teams in this league as named on ESPN Fantasy at market creation. If a team is renamed, the corresponding market will refer to that same team under its new name.

The "Other" option resolves to "Yes" only if none of the listed teams is declared the winner of the 2026 Polymarket Fantasy League championship. If the league is cancelled, or there is otherwise no single champion declared by January 19, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source will be official information from the league's page on ESPN Fantasy; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: What will the announcers say during the Falcons vs Saints game?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed term is mentioned by a play-by-play announcer or a game analyst of the official ESPN announce team during the English-language broadcast of the Atlanta Falcons vs New Orleans Saints game on ESPN, scheduled for October 5, 2026 at 8:15 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

This market will resolve based on the events of the official game broadcast, beginning from the opening kickoff and ending with the conclusion of the final play of the game, including any overtime, if applicable. Pregame coverage, halftime studio coverage, and postgame commentary will not be considered.

For the purpose of this market, the "ESPN announce team" refers only to the play-by-play announcer and the game analyst or analysts calling this game from the broadcast booth. Remarks made by sideline reporters, rules or officiating analysts, studio hosts, guest commentators, in-booth guests, players, coaches, or any other individuals will not count toward resolution, including when such remarks air during in-game interviews or in-game segments.

The resolution source for this market is the national ESPN telecast of this game. Any alternate or simultaneous presentation of this game, including alternate broadcasts, alternate audio or commentary feeds, and separately produced local team telecasts, will not be considered for resolution purposes. Only remarks made live during the official broadcast will count toward this market's resolution. Transcripts will not count.

For full rules, see: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/market_products/Mentions/Event+Mentions+Contract+DeFi.pdf
